name: brain
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one small premium 3D illustration for the DiagnoAssist Arabic clinical website, part of a coordinated three-icon set.
Style/medium: premium modern 3D product render. Translucent emerald jade and pale mint glass with matte pearl-white elements, restrained cyan accents, smooth rounded bevels, obvious dimensional depth. Clean calm clinical aesthetic.
Composition/framing: 1024 x 1024 square PNG with ACTUAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND. Center a single icon with generous transparent margins. Coherent 3/4 isometric camera, viewed slightly from above. The silhouette must be instantly recognizable at 96px.
Lighting/mood: soft studio lighting from upper left, delicate highlights and subtle contact shadow. No visible floor, backdrop, base, platform or frame.
Constraints: isolated object on real transparent background. No text, letters, numerals, logo or watermark. No background color or gradient. No black background. No surrounding decorative objects.
Primary request: a stylized human brain icon. Two rounded cerebral hemispheres with broad simplified sculptural gyri and grooves, a clear center division, rendered in translucent emerald jade glass with pale mint internal depth, restrained pearl-white surface highlights and tiny cyan accent reflections. Anatomically recognizable as a brain, friendly simplified clinical symbol, no face or eyes.
